data_description.id: A unique identifier for this Welkom instance.
data_description.url: Base URL of the Welkom server.
data_description.home_id: Optional home to scope this instance to, when the server has more than one.

init.title: Auth routing
init.description: Log people in automatically from welkom's identity, mapping welkom people and roles to Home Assistant users.

data.auth_require_full_role: Only identify people at their full role

data_description.create_entities: Publish welkom's presence entities (device trackers, sensors). Turn off to run this instance for auth only — e.g. when presence is already bridged from another Home Assistant.
data_description.auth_enabled: Inject a welkom auth provider that identifies each request from welkom's forward-auth headers.
data_description.auth_allow_bypass_login: Log matched users straight in instead of showing a login screen.
data_description.auth_require_full_role: Recommended. Only log someone into their own account on networks that grant them their full role; on a lower-trust network they fall back to the role account, so a spoofed device can't escalate past the network's max role.
data_description.auth_default_user: Fallback Home Assistant user when neither the person nor the role maps to one.

people.title: People → Home Assistant users
people.description: The Home Assistant user each welkom person is logged in as. Leave on “fall back to role” to use the role mapping instead.

roles.title: Roles → Home Assistant users
roles.description: The shared account each welkom role is logged in as when the person isn't mapped. Leave on “use default” to use the default user.
